fields.question: What is an NFC card?
fields.answer: An NFC (Near Field Communication) card is a smart card embedded with a chip that lets you share your digital business card, social profiles, and contact details with a single tap on any NFC-enabled smartphone — no app required.

fields.question: How does VR's NEXORA card work?
fields.answer: Simply tap your VR's NEXORA card on the back of any NFC-enabled smartphone. Your digital profile opens instantly in the recipient's browser, letting them view your details, save your contact, and connect on social media. If NFC isn't supported, they can scan the QR code instead.

fields.question: Do I need any app to use the card?
fields.answer: No. Recipients don't need to install any app to view your profile. You only need to sign in to your VR's NEXORA dashboard to activate and manage your card and profile.

fields.question: Can I update my profile details later?
fields.answer: Yes, absolutely. You can update your name, designation, company, photo, bio, and social links anytime from your customer dashboard. Changes reflect instantly on your live profile without needing a new card.

fields.question: Is my data secure?
fields.answer: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption for all stored data and never share your information with third parties without consent. You have full control over which details are visible on your public profile.

fields.question: What if my card is lost or damaged?
fields.answer: You can order a replacement card from your dashboard and simply reassign your existing profile to the new card's UID. Your profile link and QR code remain unaffected.

fields.question: How long does delivery take?
fields.answer: Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days and delivered within 5-7 business days across India via our logistics partners.

fields.question: Can I use one VR's NEXORA card for a business team?
fields.answer: Yes, our Business and Enterprise plans support bulk card ordering and centralized team management from a single admin panel.
